name: Support knowledge-base access policy example
answer:
Workspace admins can grant agents access to the internal knowledge base.
Knowledge-base access is removed within 24 hours after an agent leaves the workspace.
Support automatically grants a premium discount to every guest collaborator.

sources.title: Support Knowledge-Base Access Policy
sources.content:
Workspace admins can grant agents access to the internal knowledge base.
Knowledge-base access is removed within 7 days after an agent leaves the workspace.
Guest collaborators do not receive knowledge-base access unless an administrator approves it.
